page.overview:
Who is Whirlypoo?

is a laughter earth pony. He was played by Roger Craig Smith in .

Whirlypoo is an earth pony. He has a dark coat with white dots, a white mane, and bright blue eyes. His cutie mark is a whirlpool galaxy with blue and purple streaks. Whirlypoo carried a pair of binoculars tied on a string around his neck.

Whirlypoo likes to spin really fast and throw things really far. He is easily distracted by bright things in the sky and loves laughter.
